newsitem.title: USA: Attache-US 97/8 wheat exports to Egpyt near double.
newsitem.headline: Attache-US 97/8 wheat exports to Egpyt near double.

text.p: A U.S. agricultural attache forecast marketing year 1997/98 U.S. wheat exports to Egypt would nearly double to 4.0 million tonnes from 1996/97's 2.0 million tonnes pace but lag 1995/96's 6.0 million tonnes.

High U.S. prices combined with big exportable supplies from Argentina, Australia and France sapped U.S. share in the Egyptian market, which fell from over 90 percent in marketing year 1995/96 to about 35 percent in 1996/97, the attache said in a report dated March 10 released here Thursday.
The attache said U.S. wheat sales from July 1, 1996 until end of February were at 1,600,000 tonnes, out of total 5,255,000 tonnes.

"However, with shrinking exportable supplies from both Argentina and France, as well as concerns in Australia over lack of rain, U.S. wheat exports are expected to improve significantly over the remaining months of this marketing year, and into MY 1997/98," the attache wrote.
Attache reports are not official USDA data.
